text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّمَا كَانَ قَوْلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذَا دُعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۚ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ

words.gloss_range: restrictive particle opening the believers' response as the only admissible reply

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: closing separator pronoun that mirrors the opening restriction

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّمَا}} ({{tr:innamā}}) opens by restricting the field before the response is even quoted: when the summons comes, the believers' saying is not one acceptable answer among others. The fused particle makes exclusion and focus work together, and its opening restriction is answered by the closing separator {{ar:هُمُ}} ({{tr:humu}}), so the ayah is framed by restricted speech and restricted successful identity.

topics.headline: opening restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah first closes off alternative responses and only then names the single faithful formula.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the opener as a restrictive particle, and the attached clause frame supports its scope over the response scene.

topics.headline: double restriction frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah's beginning and end both restrict, enclosing summons, speech, and verdict inside one tight frame.
topics.reason: The closing nominal clause is syntactically separate but aligned with the initial restriction as a discourse frame.

words.gloss_range: perfect copular state anchor in the restricted clause
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, and state-existence; locally a copular/stative frame for the believers' saying

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: advanced accusative speech noun in the restricted copular construction

words.prose: {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) makes the restricted answer sound like an established state, not a one-off report. In the standard syntax, {{ar:قَوْلَ}} ({{tr:qawla}}) is advanced as the accusative predicate, while the delayed saying-clause supplies the subject; this order lets the defining speech-form arrive before its exact quoted wording. Existential overtones can be heard, but the local work remains copular and state-forming, threading the surah's legal and social state language into this response definition.

topics.headline: state anchor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the faithful response as a settled identity-state rather than an isolated past utterance.
topics.reason: The perfect verb and local copular construction license state-definition; broader existential language is kept as pressure rather than the sole parse.

topics.headline: advanced predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speech label is foregrounded before the quotation, making the answer a class-defining predicate.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the accusative speech noun as the predicate linked to the delayed content clause.

topics.headline: surah state recurrence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can connect this state-defining use with the surah's broader legal and social state language.
topics.reason: The recurrence claim is compatible with the local legal-response frame and does not override the grammar.

words.gloss_range: singular construct verbal noun naming the believers' formal response
words.root_gloss_range: saying, utterance, statement, and held position; locally a formal speech act whose content follows

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: definite believer class linked to the speech noun by construct relation
copular verb governing the standard accusative predicate analysis
accepted nominative variant shifting the subject-predicate analysis
later same-root speech verb introducing the quoted response

words.prose: {{ar:قَوْلَ}} ({{tr:qawla}}) compresses the believers' answer into a singular speech-act noun: many believers are bound to one known utterance through its construct link with {{ar:ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ}} ({{tr:al-muʾminīna}}). Its accusative case supports the standard reading as the predicate of {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}), while the accepted {{ar:قَوْلُ}} ({{tr:qawlu}}) variant shifts subject and predicate roles without removing the restriction. The same root later returns in {{ar:يَقُولُوا}} ({{tr:yaqūlū}}), so the ayah first names speech and then performs it, in contrast with false profession in 24:47.

topics.headline: singular construct speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one definite speech-form belonging to the believer class, not scattered individual replies.
topics.reason: The singular verbal noun and construct attachment to the definite plural possessor support this local speech-act reading.

topics.headline: case and variant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the standard case foregrounds the speech noun, while the variant changes syntax without changing the faithful-response core.
topics.reason: The standard local parse is accusative predicate; the nominative variant is valid as contrast but does not govern the canonical parse.

topics.headline: speech contrast and enclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah reverse empty speech from 24:47 by enclosing the true response between a speech noun and a speech verb.
topics.reason: The concrete 24:47 contrast and local same-root repetition are both anchored in the row evidence and local word order.

words.gloss_range: definite active-participle plural in genitive construct relation
words.root_gloss_range: faith, trust, security, and entrustment; locally the known believer class whose response verifies that identity
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ}} ({{tr:al-muʾminīna}}) is definite and genitive in the construct phrase, so the ayah is not introducing an unknown group but naming the known faithful class as possessors and agents of the required speech. The active participle makes belief an ongoing identity; the trust-and-security field remains meaningful because the summons tests whether their trust becomes obedient acceptance. Against 24:47, where belief is claimed and then contradicted, this title anchors the positive portrait.

topics.headline: known believer class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the believers as an already known class whose identity is being defined under summons.
topics.reason: The definite plural and genitive construct relation support the class-identifying function.

topics.headline: trust identity tested
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees faith here as an ongoing trust identity that must show itself in hearing and obedience.
topics.reason: The active participle licenses ongoing identity; broader security and entrustment language is retained as root pressure under the local response frame.

topics.headline: false and true faith contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this believer title to the contrast with the refused summons and claimed belief in 24:47.
topics.reason: The row evidence gives concrete 24:47 contrast, and the local ayah supplies the positive response.

words.gloss_range: temporal-conditional adverb setting the recurring summons condition
words.prose: {{ar:إِذَا}} ({{tr:idhā}}) makes the scene a when/whenever condition, not a remote hypothetical. It stands between the restricted speech label and the quoted formula, so the reader must pass through the summons before hearing the answer. The same trigger recalls 24:48, where the summons produced refusal; here the trigger stays constant and the response changes.

topics.headline: expected condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the faithful formula as the regular answer whenever the summons occurs.
topics.reason: The adverbial temporal clause is syntactically forced and supports the expected condition reading.

topics.headline: condition hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the condition mediates between restriction and content while reversing the outcome of 24:48.
topics.reason: The clause placement and concrete 24:48 echo are locally coherent.

words.gloss_range: perfect passive summons received by the believers
words.root_gloss_range: calling, summoning, invoking, and supplicating; locally a formal summons to judgment

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: purpose clause narrowing the summons into formal arbitration

words.prose: {{ar:دُعُوا}} ({{tr:duʿū}}) is passive, so the caller is suppressed and the received summons itself becomes the test. The perfect form presents the call as an event that has reached them and now demands response. The root's call/prayer range gives devotional pressure, but the purpose clause {{ar:لِيَحْكُمَ}} ({{tr:li-yaḥkuma}}) narrows the local sense to formal arbitration; this repeats the summons frame of 24:48 with the response variable reversed.

topics.headline: passive received summons
topics.reader_payoff: The reader focuses on the fact of being summoned rather than on identifying the caller.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify a passive perfect with no overt agent.

topics.headline: arbitration call
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a call with devotional resonance, locally narrowed into a summons for judgment.
topics.reason: The root has broader call/supplication range, but the purpose clause and destination phrase select legal summons here.

topics.headline: repeated summons contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 24:48 and 24:51 hold the summons wording steady while refusal changes into acceptance.
topics.reason: The concrete 24:48 echo is row-supplied and matches the local summons phrase.

words.gloss_range: directional preposition marking the summons destination and goal

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: proper divine name as the governed endpoint of the summons

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) gives the passive summons a direction and endpoint: it is a call toward {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) and His messenger, not a loose invitation. Because the direction phrase comes before the purpose clause, the destination of authority is fixed before the legal aim is named.

topics.headline: directional summons
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the summons moving toward a named authority before its arbitration purpose is stated.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the divine name after the passive summons and precedes the purpose clause.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name governed by the directional preposition
words.root_gloss_range: divinity, worship, and awe/bewilderment in derivational discussion; locally the proper name anchoring authority

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: directional preposition governing the divine name
messenger coordinated with the divine name under the same summons destination

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) is the genitive endpoint governed by {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}), anchoring the summons in divine authority before the messenger is coordinated with it. Derivational discussions can color the authority with worship and awe, but the local grammar keeps the proper divine name primary rather than a generic deity term. The following conjunction makes {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) and {{ar:رَسُولِهِ}} ({{tr:rasūlihi}}) one governed destination for judgment.

topics.headline: divine destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the arbitration summons anchored first in the proper divine name, not in an unnamed authority.
topics.reason: The proper noun is genitive under the directional preposition and functions as the named destination.

topics.headline: paired authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that God and messenger are grammatically joined under one summons destination while remaining distinct terms.
topics.reason: The coordination evidence supports a single governed destination; derivational color is retained only as secondary pressure.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining messenger to God under the same preposition

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first term coordinated with the messenger
preposition governing the coordinated authority phrase

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the messenger with {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) under the same {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) phrase. That makes the messenger part of the summons destination without collapsing him appositionally into the divine name; the legal response is directed toward a paired authority structure.

topics.headline: coordinated authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the conjunction joins God and messenger in one governed summons while preserving their distinct roles.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the relation as coordination, not apposition or accompaniment.

words.gloss_range: genitive messenger noun with divine possessive suffix
words.root_gloss_range: sending, being sent, emissary function; locally God's messenger in the judgment summons

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: divine name to which the messenger is coordinated and possessed

words.prose: {{ar:رَسُولِهِ}} ({{tr:rasūlihi}}) is genitive by coordination with {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}), and the attached suffix binds the messenger to God. The root and noun pattern keep sentness visible: this is not an independent judge added beside God but God's sent messenger implementing the summons. The link to {{ar:لِيَحْكُمَ}} ({{tr:li-yaḥkuma}}) makes the messenger's role especially judicial inside the surah's arbitration and obedience sequence.

topics.headline: divinely possessed messenger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the messenger's authority as sent and possessed by God within the same summons phrase.
topics.reason: The genitive coordination and 3ms suffix support divine possession and sent-messenger authority.

topics.headline: messenger as judicial agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sent role is locally exercised through judgment and obedience, not merely message delivery.
topics.reason: The purpose clause licenses judicial implementation, while broader messenger semantics are narrowed to this arbitration context.

topics.headline: obedience section recurrence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can track the messenger title through the surah's arbitration and obedience sequence.
topics.reason: The recurrence claim supports local continuity without changing the word's grammatical function.

words.gloss_range: purposive bound preposition governing the subjunctive judgment verb
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) is purposive here, not possessive: it attaches directly to the subjunctive judgment verb and states why the summons is issued. The particle pivots the line from the destination of authority to the legal aim, so being called to God and His messenger is immediately specified as being called for judgment.

topics.headline: purpose lam
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the summons move from authority destination to stated legal purpose.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence both identify a purposive preposition governing the following subjunctive.

topics.headline: destination to aim pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle turns the authority phrase into a concrete arbitration aim.
topics.reason: The local syntax places the purpose clause after the governed destination phrase.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive Form I judgment verb governed by purposive lam
words.root_gloss_range: judging, ruling, restraining, wisdom, and firmness; locally legal arbitration between parties

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: purposive particle governing the subjunctive judgment verb
between-them complement selecting legal arbitration

words.prose: {{ar:يَحْكُمَ}} ({{tr:yaḥkuma}}) names the purpose of the summons: judgment between the parties. The purposive {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) controls its subjunctive mood, and {{ar:بَيْنَهُمْ}} ({{tr:baynahum}}) selects the legal-arbitration sense from the wider judgment, wisdom, and firmness field. The 3ms subject remains locally implicit; passive and Form IV variant reports can foreground the judgment process or firmness, but the canonical surface keeps an active Form I judging verb. This repeats 24:48's judgment frame and answers the injustice diagnosis of 24:50 with accepted arbitration.

topics.headline: subjunctive purpose judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees judgment as the explicit purpose of being summoned, not an incidental outcome.
topics.reason: The purposive particle governs the subjunctive verb, and the between-phrase fixes the arbitration domain.

topics.headline: implicit and variant judge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the canonical verb leaves the judge implicit, while variant reports can shift attention toward the judgment process itself.
topics.reason: The canonical surface is active with an implicit 3ms subject; passive and Form IV variants are retained as apparatus-level contrasts.

topics.headline: legal firmness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears arbitration as judgment with firmness and wisdom pressure, while local syntax keeps ruling between parties primary.
topics.reason: The root-family pressure is coherent, but the local complement selects legal judgment rather than a broad wisdom abstraction.

topics.headline: judgment frame reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same judgment frame as 24:48 now received positively rather than avoided.
topics.reason: The row evidence gives the 24:48 link and the surrounding discourse supports the reversal.

words.gloss_range: adverbial between-space with 3mp suffix marking the parties
words.root_gloss_range: between-ness, separation, distinction, clarity, and evidence; locally the domain of arbitration between them

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: attached plural suffix marking the parties whose between-space is judged
judgment verb governed by the between-them adverbial

words.prose: {{ar:بَيْنَهُمْ}} ({{tr:baynahum}}) gives the judgment its domain: the space between the parties. The attached {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) keeps that interval tied to the involved group, while the root's clarity and separation field makes the legal between-space more than location; it is where disputed relations are distinguished and clarified. This anchors the recurring arbitration formula with {{ar:يَحْكُمَ}} ({{tr:yaḥkuma}}).

topics.headline: possessed between-space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees judgment located in the relational space between the parties, not as an abstract ruling detached from them.
topics.reason: The word is an adverbial complement to the judgment verb and carries an attached plural pronoun.

topics.headline: clarified arbitration space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the between-space as the place where separation and clarity are produced by judgment.
topics.reason: The root-family pressure is valid but locally remains attached to an adverbial arbitration domain.

topics.headline: arbitration formula recurrence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can track the judgment-between formula as a repeated marker of dispute, command, and boundary order.
topics.reason: The recurrence claim supports the local legal formula without changing the adverbial parse.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive complementizer nominalizing the speech clause
words.prose: {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) turns the following verb into a nominalized saying-clause, supplying the delayed content of the believers' speech. It opens the direct-speech content only after the temporal summons and judgment purpose have closed, so the answer is heard as the defined response to that legal situation.

topics.headline: nominalized saying content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the quotation as the delayed content of the restricted speech noun, not as a loose new clause.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the following clause as the content complement of the speech noun.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive plural speech verb introducing the quoted response
words.root_gloss_range: saying, uttering, stating, and taking a position; locally performative quoted response

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: subjunctive complementizer governing the speech verb

words.prose: {{ar:يَقُولُوا}} ({{tr:yaqūlū}}) is governed by {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) and carries the believers into the quoted answer. Its imperfect form inside the nominalized clause keeps the response repeatable under the whenever-condition, while the plural ending moves the narrative into the speakers' collective voice. The same root echoes {{ar:قَوْلَ}} ({{tr:qawla}}), and the phrasing reverses the earlier verbal obedience claim in 24:47 by making speech perform acceptance.

topics.headline: subjunctive performative speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the quoted words as the required performed response under the nominalized clause.
topics.reason: The verb is subjunctive under the complementizer and introduces the quoted utterance.

topics.headline: repeatable collective response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the believers' collective voice entering a repeatable response pattern.
topics.reason: The 3mp ending and imperfect form support communal repeatability under the condition.

topics.headline: speech echo and reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the root echo from speech label to speech verb, now reversing the failed speech of 24:47.
topics.reason: The same-root enclosure and 24:47 contrast are directly supplied by the CRITICAL rows.

words.gloss_range: first-person plural perfect hearing as received acceptance
words.root_gloss_range: hearing, listening, answering, and accepting; locally heard reception that begins obedient response

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: shared first-person plural ending in the paired response verbs
coordinated obedience verb completing the formula

words.prose: {{ar:سَمِعْنَا}} ({{tr:samiʿnā}}) begins the quoted answer with perfect first-person plural hearing. In this formula, hearing is not mere sound registration but received acceptance, and the Form I perfect keeps the response direct rather than effortful or causative. The shared {{ar:نَا}} ({{tr:nā}}) cadence with {{ar:أَطَعْنَا}} ({{tr:aṭaʿnā}}) turns hearing and obedience into one communal utterance. The formula aligns with 2:285, contrasts with 2:93, and answers the surah's earlier failed hearing scene in 24:12 and refused judgment scene in 24:48.

topics.headline: hearing as acceptance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first verb as accepting reception, not bare auditory perception.
topics.reason: The acceptance sense is coherent in the quoted response formula, while the local form remains ordinary Form I perfect hearing.

topics.headline: communal formula cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first-person plural ending and cadence bind the speakers as a single responding community.
topics.reason: The paired perfect verbs share person, number, and final cadence in the quoted response.

topics.headline: formula and contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the phrase with the compliance formula of 2:285, its disobedient contrast in 2:93, and the local reversal of refusal from 24:48.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah references are concrete and the local formula exactly supplies the hearing half.

topics.headline: surah hearing return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees hearing move from failed ethical response in 24:12 into accepted arbitration response here.
topics.reason: The same-root recurrence supports a local surah-level return without overriding the formulaic meaning.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction binding hearing and obedience inside the quotation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first perfect verb in the paired response

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins {{ar:سَمِعْنَا}} ({{tr:samiʿnā}}) and {{ar:أَطَعْنَا}} ({{tr:aṭaʿnā}}) as paired perfect declarations. The conjunction preserves two distinct acts, reception and compliance, while binding them into one formula; the repeated {{ar:نَا}} ({{tr:nā}}) ending makes the pair sound like one communal response rather than a loose list.

topics.headline: paired hearing and obedience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees obedience grammatically bound to hearing while still kept as a distinct act.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies coordination of the two quoted perfect verbs.

topics.headline: plural cadence binding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the shared plural ending as part of the conjunction's binding effect.
topics.reason: The phonetic claim is local to the coordinated pair and remains tied to the grammatical conjunction.

words.gloss_range: first-person plural Form IV perfect obedience within the authority frame
words.root_gloss_range: obedience, willingness, compliance, and capacity; locally directed obedience to the summoned authority

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: divine authority supplied by the preceding summons frame

words.prose: {{ar:أَطَعْنَا}} ({{tr:aṭaʿnā}}) completes the quoted formula with Form IV directed obedience. Its object is not overt, but the preceding summons to {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) and {{ar:رَسُولِهِ}} ({{tr:rasūlihi}}) supplies the authority frame, making obedience general within that summons. The root's willingness and capacity field gives compliance the feel of willing capacity, while Form IV selects commanded obedience rather than mere ability or extra devotion. As the second verb, it turns hearing into compliance, aligns with 2:285, replaces disobedience in the contrasting 2:93 formula, and gives the surah's obedience field its positive realization.

topics.headline: directed obedience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees obedience aimed toward the authority already named, even though no object is repeated.
topics.reason: The Form IV verb and preceding authority phrase support directed compliance without requiring an overt object.

topics.headline: completed willing response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears obedience as already embraced in the response and colored by willing capacity.
topics.reason: The perfect aspect licenses completed response, while capacity/willingness is retained as root pressure under the obedience sense.

topics.headline: formula antithesis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second verb decide whether hearing becomes obedience, as in 2:285, or rebellion, as in 2:93.
topics.reason: The formulaic and antithetical references are concrete and local to the quoted pair.

topics.headline: obedience field resolution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can track the surah's obedience field resolving positively in the quoted response.
topics.reason: The recurrence claim is compatible with the immediate formula and broader surah frame.

It connects the verdict to the quoted response but also resets the syntax, so the closing statement is not part of the quotation; it is an assessment of who the responders are.

topics.headline: resumptive verdict wa

words.prose: {{ar:أُولَئِكَ}} ({{tr:ūlāʾika}}) points back to the believers characterized by saying {{ar:سَمِعْنَا}} ({{tr:samiʿnā}}) and {{ar:أَطَعْنَا}} ({{tr:aṭaʿnā}}), turning the response group into the subject of the verdict. Its distant demonstrative form sets them apart for evaluative distinction, and it launches the tripartite nominal frame {{ar:أُولَئِكَ}} ({{tr:ūlāʾika}}), {{ar:هُمُ}} ({{tr:humu}}), {{ar:ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ}} ({{tr:al-mufliḥūna}}). The same demonstrative-pronoun mechanism reverses the opposed verdict frame from 24:50 across the boundary.

topics.headline: demonstrative to responders
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the compliant responders converted from described speakers into the subject of a status verdict.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence resolves the demonstrative to the responsive believers, and the nominal clause makes it the subject.

topics.headline: distant evaluative distinction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears demonstrative distance as setting the responders apart for honor and evaluation.
topics.reason: The distant demonstrative reading is coherent as evaluative distinction after the speech act.

topics.headline: verdict frame reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the moral reversal from 24:50 because the same demonstrative-pronoun frame now points to successful responders.

words.prose: {{ar:هُمُ}} ({{tr:humu}}) stands as the separator between {{ar:أُولَئِكَ}} ({{tr:ūlāʾika}}) and {{ar:ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ}} ({{tr:al-mufliḥūna}}). Because it is an independent word rather than a suffix, it tightens the nominal verdict into emphatic identification: those responders, they are the successful ones. This closing restriction mirrors the opening restriction of {{ar:إِنَّمَا}} ({{tr:innamā}}) and carries the boundary's reversal of the verdict grammar from 24:50.

topics.headline: separator pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the pronoun tighten subject and predicate into an emphatic identity verdict.
topics.reason: QAC marks the pronoun as expletive/separating, and the predicate relation confirms its place in the nominal clause.

topics.headline: closing restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends by restricting successful identity just as it began by restricting the proper speech.
topics.reason: The separator force and opening restrictive particle form a coherent frame over the ayah.

topics.headline: reversed verdict pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ}} ({{tr:al-mufliḥūna}}) closes the ayah as the predicate of the nominal verdict. Its definite active-participle form makes success an identified state of those responders, not a passing event. The root's cleaving and cultivation imagery lets success feel like breakthrough after hearing and obeying, while Form IV active-participle morphology keeps the successful agents visible without turning the word into a claim that they independently cause all success. The formula recalls 23:1 and 3:104, returns from hoped success in 24:31 to affirmed identity here, and reverses the verdict frame of 24:50 by replacing injustice with success.

topics.headline: definite success identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees success assigned as a stable identified status for the responders.
topics.reason: The definite active participle serves as the predicate of the closing nominal clause.

topics.headline: breakthrough root image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears success with breakthrough and cultivation pressure rather than generic prosperity alone.
topics.reason: The root image is meaningful, but agency language is narrowed so the local predicate remains an affirmed successful identity.

topics.headline: success formula and return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the closing with known success formulas in 23:1 and 3:104 and with the surah's move from hoped success in 24:31 to affirmed success here.
topics.reason: The cited formula references and local 24:31 return are concrete and compatible with the closing predicate.

topics.headline: opposite verdict closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same verdict architecture from 24:50 close on success rather than injustice, with the active-participle ending reinforcing the reversal.
topics.reason: The row evidence ties the closing word to the ayah's restriction architecture and the opposite verdict frame of 24:50.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: دُعُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ ... سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا
baseline_models.mechanism: A spoken summons draws disputants into an entrusted forum; adjudication addresses the interval between them, hearing completes as compliance, and falah names the durable outcome of letting that circuit close.

activation_trace.role: Calling and inclining by speech initiates movement toward the adjudicative forum.
The messenger and carried message identify the entrusted channel to which the summons directs them.
Judgment between people supplies the forum's concrete work of deciding the dispute.
The middle or interval between parties locates the dispute and the ruling's relational field.
Hearing as understanding and implementation makes reception an operative stage rather than bare acoustics.
Compliance carries the received ruling into conduct and closes the response circuit.
Winning, survival, and attainment name the lasting result of completed response.

changed_reading.before: The ayah commends generic obedience after an address.
changed_reading.after: It defines belief as closing a concrete adjudicative circuit: answer the summons, receive the ruling, and enact it so dispute can reach durable success.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَوْلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ... أَن يَقُولُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا
baseline_models.mechanism: The doubled saying does more than prescribe words: the first qawl identifies the believers' characteristic response, while the second is authenticated by the coupled acts of understanding and compliance.

activation_trace.role: A thing's 'saying' as its indication lets the voiced formula function as a diagnostic sign of identity.
Heart-settling assent supplies the inward identity that the response must visibly indicate.
Understanding that tends toward implementation prevents 'we heard' from remaining a verbal claim.
Actual compliance is the behavioral verification of the believers' saying.

changed_reading.before: The defining response is a prescribed phrase.
changed_reading.after: The phrase is a testable sign of believing identity: 'we heard' becomes true as a social claim only in the ensuing compliance.

baseline_models.mechanism: Judgment can restrain damaging conduct for reform, work within the connection between the parties, and cut an opening through deadlock; success is therefore relational repair as well as a favorable result.

activation_trace.role: Restraint and return for reform cast judgment as stopping the damage that sustains conflict.
The connection standing between parties makes their relation, not only their rival claims, an object of repair.
Cutting or opening supplies the image of making a passage through an otherwise closed dispute.

changed_reading.before: Judgment merely selects a winner between two sides.
changed_reading.after: Judgment can also restrain the damage and reopen the relation between sides; accepting that corrective opening is itself part of flourishing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first trains hearing under evidentiary discipline: testimony must speak from knowledge, while heard accusation must be stopped rather than passed mouth to mouth. The focus response therefore follows an authorized adjudication, not an indiscriminate readiness to obey whatever is heard.

activation_trace.role: Testimony as declaration from knowledge supplies an evidentiary gate before a damaging claim is accepted.
Auditory reception supplies the earlier test case in which merely hearing an allegation does not authorize relaying it.
Emitted speech supplies the harmful relay that disciplined hearing must refuse to reproduce.
Knowledge as disclosure is explicitly absent, exposing the relay as speech detached from known reality.
Understanding that governs response turns the second hearing scene into a model of ethical refusal.
In the focus, understanding and implementation now receive the outcome of a legitimate judgment.
Adjudication between people is the institutional filter that distinguishes this hearing from rumor uptake.

structural_cues: 24:4 and 24:13 require witnesses before punitive accusation is accepted.
24:12-16 twice stage hearing an accusation and prescribe speech that stops, rather than circulates, unsupported claims.
24:51 places hearing after summons to adjudication, not inside the rumor chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contrasted hearing-speech sequences and witness requirements; I infer that authorized adjudication filters what is heard before obedience. A live alternative is that 24:51 stresses readiness alone without commenting on procedure.

changed_reading.before: 'We heard' means unqualified receptivity to whatever reaches the ear.
changed_reading.after: 'We heard' is disciplined uptake of an adjudicated claim: believers refuse unsupported speech, yet enact a determination reached through an authorized forum.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence contrasts professed obedience followed by withdrawal, refusal of the same summons, eager submission only when one's right is secured, fear of judicial bias, and strenuous oaths. Against those failures, the focus saying is a precommitment whose truth appears when the outcome is uncertain or adverse.

activation_trace.role: Turning the back supplies the behavioral contradiction to the preceding profession of belief and obedience.
Presenting one's side and turning away supplies the concrete refusal of the identical adjudicative summons.
A right specifically possessed by its owner marks the favorable condition under which selective respondents eagerly attend.
Submission and compliance become a self-interest control because they appear when the right belongs to the respondents.
Deviation in judgment names the feared possibility that tests whether trust survives an uncertain outcome.
A solemnly apportioned oath supplies the surplus verbal assurance that the sequence refuses to treat as proof.
Intended action supplies the observable criterion placed over strenuous swearing.
Saying as indication makes the focus formula evidential only insofar as conduct bears it out.
Actual compliance verifies the saying precisely where selective submission would fail.

structural_cues: 24:47 places 'we believe and obey' immediately before a faction turns away.
24:48 repeats the focus summons, while 24:49 makes attendance conditional on the right being theirs.
24:53 rejects strenuous oaths as a substitute for recognizable obedience and known deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies professions, withdrawal, favorable-case submission, fear of bias, oaths, and deeds; I infer a counterfactual test of accepting an unknown or adverse ruling. A live alternative is that the contrast concerns hypocrisy generally rather than adverse outcomes specifically.

changed_reading.before: The formula reports compliance once a congenial ruling is known.
changed_reading.after: The formula is a precommitment to impartial judgment: its truth is exposed when the ruling may frustrate one's own claim, and conduct rather than oath authenticates it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated clarification, illumination, and guidance activate a second value of the focus's بَيْنَهُمْ: the adjudicative interval is not merely where a verdict lands but where obscured facts and relations become legible enough for informed response.

activation_trace.role: Manifest and disclosed signs establish clarification as the surah's opening epistemic action.
Uncovering meaning through word or sign makes clarification an ongoing communicative process.
Light and illumination supply the surah's central image for making what guides action visible.
Clear signs immediately before the dispute sequence reactivate disclosure beside the focus's locative 'between.'
Gentle direction toward path and truth gives clarification a practical destination rather than leaving it as display.
The interval between parties is the concrete location into which the disclosure model is activated.
Knowledge that hits the right judgment supplies the epistemic quality needed to clarify the interval.

structural_cues: The surah opens with clear signs and repeatedly returns to God clarifying signs.
The light passage at 24:35 makes visibility a mechanism of guidance.
24:46 places clear signs and a straight path immediately before the speech-and-judgment sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated ب ي ن clarification branches, light, guidance, and the focus's locative بَيْنَهُمْ; I activate disclosure inside that interval. The primary live alternative is that بَيْنَهُمْ remains strictly locative and contributes no epistemic overtone.

changed_reading.before: 'Judge between them' only means issue a decision among parties.
changed_reading.after: It can also mean opening the disputed interval to clarity, making facts and relations legible enough that hearing may become responsible compliance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across homes, private times, and collective affairs, movement across a boundary is regulated by permission and responsive return. The summons into adjudication becomes another social threshold: believers neither invade on unilateral desire nor evade under cover, but enter the shared process when called and yield control to its ruling.

activation_trace.role: Entering an interior supplies the basic threshold crossing that the surah subjects to authorization.
Permission and licensing make another party's authorization, not the mover's desire, govern entry.
Returning when told supplies a compact earlier example of hearing a boundary and enacting it.
Repeated permission governs departure from a shared affair and extends threshold ethics into collective action.
Slipping out supplies the unauthorized exit that reverses open responsiveness to the messenger's call.
Hiding behind another supplies the covert social mechanism by which accountability is evaded.
The call inclines disputants across the threshold into a shared adjudicative process.
Entrusting judgment transfers unilateral control of the dispute to an authorized decider.
Compliance accepts the forum's boundary on self-directed action after entry.

structural_cues: 24:27-28 prohibit entry without authorization and require immediate return when return is spoken.
24:58-59 repeat permission rules at vulnerable private times.
24:62-63 govern leaving a collective affair and expose covert slipping away from the messenger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated authorized entry and exit scenes plus the focus summons; I infer a shared threshold mechanism across private, collective, and judicial domains. A live alternative is that the privacy rules remain domain-specific and do not color adjudication.

changed_reading.before: The ayah concerns courtroom obedience in isolation.
changed_reading.after: It participates in a surah-wide ethics of authorized movement: do not cross social boundaries by unilateral desire, and when called into judgment, surrender the dispute to shared rule.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fear that the judge may deviate blocks the immediate respondents, while the later promise joins belief, empowerment, and the replacement of fear with security. The focus's المؤمنين and accepted judgment can therefore be read as a trust practice with a communal security horizon, not only a private virtue.

activation_trace.role: Anticipatory fear supplies the affect that makes parties suspect and avoid an uncertain judgment.
A promise that opens hope supplies the future communal horizon attached to belief and right action.
Empowerment supplies the institutional stability within which a shared rule can endure.
Expected harm supplies the prior condition explicitly replaced in the promise sequence.
Belief and security share the branch of heart-settling trust, linking the agents to the promised social condition.
The believers are named through security and trust at the point where they accept adjudication.
Shared judgment supplies the public practice through which trust is tested.
Durable success gives accepted judgment a horizon beyond winning the present case.

structural_cues: 24:50 names fear of judicial deviation as the final suspicion before the focus response.
24:55 juxtaposes those who believe with the replacement of fear by security.
24:51 calls the trust-responsive agents both believers and those who attain lasting success.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the fear-security contrast, shared ء م ن root, empowerment, and accepted judgment; I infer that repeated just response helps instantiate communal trust. A live alternative is that security is solely a divine grant and no causal institutional link is intended.

changed_reading.before: 'Believers' is an identity label and falah is individual success.
changed_reading.after: Accepting trusted judgment performs the security latent in belief and points toward a community where fear of one another's power is replaced by stable shared rule.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This meteorological-agricultural mechanism is surprising because it crosses domains and does not claim lexical equivalence. It remains anchored in the focus's relational بَيْنَهُمْ, reforming judgment, and agrarian فلاح, while 24:43 explicitly composes what is between clouds before rain emerges. Downstream prose should present it only as a controlled material analogy for conflict becoming cultivable.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another supplies the compositional action that gathers separated elements.
Connection standing between elements supplies the relational medium in which cloud composition occurs.
Descending rain supplies the beneficial release that follows composition in the contextual sequence.
Restraint for reform anchors the analogy in judgment's capacity to alter a damaging relation.
The parties' existing connection is the focus-level relational medium on which judgment works.
The cultivator who splits soil turns successful respondents into an agrarian image of reopened possibility.

changed_reading.before: The successful are simply those who receive a favorable legal outcome.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they resemble cultivators: they let reforming judgment work in the connection between parties and reopen conflict into ground where communal benefit can take root.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates material and locomotion branches rather than the ordinary legal senses. It remains anchored in the focus's bridle branch of حكم, easy gait of رسول, and enacted طاعة, and the context repeatedly contrasts straight path, turning away, and covert exit. Downstream prose should qualify it as a movement analogy, not a claim that the ayah literally describes riding.

activation_trace.role: The straight road supplies the directed course announced immediately before the judgment sequence.
Turning the back supplies the overt wrong-way movement contrasted with the focus response.
Slipping out supplies the covert trajectory by which a person evades shared accountability.
The bridle that checks an animal supplies a material image for judgment restraining self-serving momentum.
Easy, supple gait supplies the responsive motion made possible once the course is accepted.
Compliance and tractability turn auditory assent into a redirected, governed trajectory.

changed_reading.before: Hearing and obeying are static assent.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are a redirected gait: judgment reins in self-serving motion and places the respondent on a straight, publicly accountable course rather than permitting withdrawal or covert exit.

strongest_changes: The surah's accusation sequence makes 'we heard' evidence-filtered reception rather than credulity.
The immediate contrast makes 'we obeyed' a precommitment tested by an uncertain or adverse ruling, with deeds outranking professions and oaths.
Repeated clarification activates judgment as making the disputed interval legible, while permission scenes place it inside a wider ethics of authorized social movement.
The shared ء م ن field links accepted judgment to a communal horizon in which fear is replaced by security.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context converted a compact legal response into a diagnostic ecology of speech, evidence, boundaries, movement, and trust without detaching any retained model from summons, judgment, hearing, obedience, or falah in 24:51.
remaining_uncertainties: The adverse-outcome test is strongly suggested by 24:49 but may be one instance of a broader hypocrisy contrast.
The clarification sense of ب ي ن is an activation across repeated forms; the locative sense remains syntactically primary in بَيْنَهُمْ.
The institutional path from individual obedience to communal security is reader-supplied and may exceed the direct causal claim of 24:55.
The cloud-field and reined-trajectory models should remain analogical outliers, not lexical replacements.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Hearing is completed by movement, opening a way through dispute.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed-ayah `س م ع` B003 is understanding and compliance, not sound reception alone; `ط و ع` B001 is willing yielding; `ح ك م` B002 adjudication; `ب ي ن` B002/B003 is the interval and tie between parties; `ف ل ح` B001 is cleaving/opening and B005 success with lasting good. **Structural cue:** 24:46 offers a traversable path, 24:47 offers speech without corresponding action, and 24:48-50 show withdrawal and selective return; 24:52-56 then unfold winning, responsibility, security, and maintained practice. **Assigned role:** hearing receives the summons, obedience carries it into action, and the cleaving branch of `مفلحون` pictures a route opened through a closed conflict. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies call, reception, action, and success; I infer receptive understanding → willing participation → dispute becomes passable. **Reading change:** `سمعنا وأطعنا` is a two-stage operational response, not a ceremonial formula.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 24:52 made `مفلحون`'s opening image directional, and 24:55-56 showed the opened route's durable outcome: security maintained by established, purifying, coordinated practice.

baseline.text: Aralarında hüküm vermesi için Allah'a ve elçisine çağrıldıklarında inananların sözü yalnızca 'İşittik ve itaat ettik' demeleridir. Kurtuluşa erenler işte onlardır.

findings.text: İşitmek, sesi almakla tamamlanmaz; gönüllü hareketle yargı sürecine katıldığında ilişkisel düğümün içinden kalıcı bir geçit açar.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A summons to judgment reveals whether professed orientation becomes embodied approach or reverses into withdrawal, doubt, and fear of bias.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Face-turning, separated flock, judicial slope, bodily disease, optical dimming, and understood hearing make response to judgment a directional and diagnostic event.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hearing Completes Itself in Action
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A summons reaches the ear, is understood and accepted, becomes obedience, and terminates in safety and attained good.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: auditory reception `quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`; hearing as comprehension and compliance `quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`; obedience `quranic:root_000956:B001/m01`; success and continuing good `quranic:root_001175:B005/m01`; deliverance and attainment `quranic:root_001186:B001/m01`; reverent fear `quranic:root_000413:B001/m01`; placing oneself behind a protection `quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Hearing is complete only when reception passes through understanding into action. Obedience, protective caution, and reverent fear then produce two distinct outcomes: enduring flourishing and escape-with-attainment.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, bir şeyin gerçekleşip bulunur hale gelmesini çekirdek kabul eder ve buna olma adları ile geçmiş ya da şimdiki bildirme kullanımlarını bağlar. Pekiştirme, ayırma ve ettirgen oluşturma kullanımları aynı dal içinde bağımlı kullanımlar olarak durur; yer, konum ve üstlenme dalları bu çekirdeğin yerine geçirilmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gerçekleşme ve bulunma çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; yer, konum, üstlenme ve boyun eğme ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam hem yalın hem bağlı kullanımlar verdiği için tanım çekirdeği ayrı, bağlı sözleri ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal, bir şeyin gerçekleşip bulunur hale gelmesini ve bu olmanın geçmiş ya da şimdiki anda bildirilmesini anlatır. Olma adları, pekiştirme ya da ayırma işlevli bağlı sözler ve bir şeyi oldurup oluşmasını sağlama buna bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin gerçekleşmesi, ortaya çıkması ve bulunur halde olması çekirdektir.
Olma ve oluş adları bu çekirdeğin adlaştırılmış biçimleridir.
Geçmişteki bir durumun haber verilmesi veya şimdiki olmanın bildirilmesi bu alana bağlıdır.
Pekiştirme ve gelen kişiyi kapsam dışı bırakma gibi bağlı söz dizimleri çekirdeğe ek kullanımlardır.
Bir şeyi oldurmak, onun gerçekleşmesini sağlama yönünde ettirgen bir uzantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, dalı bir şeyin olması, gerçekleşmesi ve hazır bulunması etrafında toplar. Aynı bildirim içinde olma adları, geçmiş ya da şimdiki haber verme, pekiştirme, ayırma ve ettirgen oldurma kullanımları da bu çekirdeğe bağlanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sesli bir hitap gelmeden anlamın kişinin içine doğmasını ve bunun söz diye adlandırılmasını anlatır. Çerçeve, işitilen konuşmadan ayrılan içe doğan anlam aktarımını doğru yakalar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal içe doğan anlam aktarımıdır; işitilen sözlü hitap değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam non_bare olduğu için tanım özel içe doğma bağlamıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: İşitilen bir hitap olmadan, bir anlamın kişinin içine doğması ve bunun söz diye adlandırılmasıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, sözsüz biçimde içe doğan anlam aktarımıdır.
Bu kullanım işitilen hitabı özellikle dışarıda bırakır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt bu özel dalı tek bir aktarım üzerinden verir; ortaklaştırılacak ayrı bir çok kaynaklı iddia yoktur.

source_details.summary: Tekil aktarım, işitilen hitap olmaksızın içe doğan anlamın söz diye adlandırılmasını verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sesli hitap olmadan kişiye gelen anlamın söz diye adlandırıldığı bağlam için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İçe doğan anlam aktarımını korur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه القول في الإلهام، حيث يسمى إلقاء المعنى قولا من غير خطاب وارد.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الخطاب اللفظي المسموع.
branches.source_phrase_ar: في الإلهام فإن ذلك لم يكن بخطاب ورد عليه بل كان ذلك إلهاما فسماه قولا (mufradat)

source_note.MU: Tekil aktarım, işitilen hitap olmaksızın içe doğan anlamın söz diye adlandırılmasını verir.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök, sesle söze dökme çekirdeğinden konuşma organı, konuşkan kişi, eski unvan, yalan isnat, söylenti, müzakere, hüküm dayatma, iç söz, görüş benimseme, sözsüz belirtme, içten önemseme, teknik tanım ve içe doğan anlam gibi ayrı dallara yayılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi azlığı çokluğun karşıtı olarak verir; ayrıca yoksulluk, düşüklük, bir şeyi az görme ve belirli yapılarda yokluğa ya da seyrekliğe yaklaşan kullanımları açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol yalnızca sayı ve miktar azlığını ve buna bağlı kullanımları kapsar; yükseklik, kap, taşıma ve titreme anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel azlık anlamı ile yoksullaşma ve az görme gibi türemiş biçimler birlikte bulunur; yokluk ve seyrekleşme anlamları ise yalnızca belirtilen yapılara bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sayı, miktar ya da ölçü bakımından çok olmayışını bildirir. Bundan yoksulluk ve düşüklük, bir şeyi az sayma veya az gösterme ve belirli yapılarda hiçlik ya da seyrek gerçekleşme anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar azlığın temel sayı ve miktar karşıtlığında birleşir; yoksulluk ve düşüklük, az sayma ve bazı yapılarda yokluğa yaklaşan kullanım bu çekirdeğin düzenli uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sayı, miktar veya ölçünün çok olmayışını bildiren temel anlam için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Çokluğun karşıtı olan sayı ve miktar azlığını doğrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin sayı veya miktar bakımından çok olmadığının söylendiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Temel azlık durumunu doğal bir Türkçe yapıyla tam olarak verir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Azlığın kişide yoksulluk ve toplumsal düşüklük sonucu doğurduğu bağlamlara özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Yoksulluk ile düşüklük arasındaki kaynakta kurulan uzantıyı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir miktarın veya verilen bir şeyin yetersiz ya da küçük sayıldığı değerlendirme bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Değerlendiren kişinin bir şeyi az sayması anlamını tam olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca sıklığı çok düşüren veya olumsuzluğu pekiştiren kalıplaşmış yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kalıba bağlı seyrekleşme ve yokluğa yaklaşma değerlerini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolda değersizlik azlığın uzantısıdır; komşu kolda ise zayıflık ve aşağılık bağımsız çekirdektir, bu yüzden olağan kullanımda birbirlerinin yerine geçmezler.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; genel azlıkla en yakın örtüşme, değersizlikle kurulan yan ilişki ve aynı kökteki tepe anlamıyla olası karışma en açıklayıcı üç sınır olarak seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: القليل والقِلَّة ضد الكثرة، ويدخل فيه الافتقار والذلة، وتقليل الشيء في العين، واستقلاله، واستعمال القليل للنفي أو للندرة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس علو الشيء ولا الجرة ولا الحمل ولا الرعدة
branches.source_phrase_ar: القل القليل؛ رماه الله بالقل والذل أي بالقلة والذلة (jamhara)؛ شيء قليل وجمعه قلل؛ قل الشيء يقل قلة؛ قلله في عينه؛ أقل افتقر؛ استقله عده قليلا (sihah)؛ قل الشيء يقل قلة فهو قليل وقلال؛ القل من الرجال الخسيس الدنيء؛ قليلة ولا كثيرة؛ قليلا ما يؤمنون؛ قاللت لفلان؛ تقاللت ما أعطاني (tahdhib)؛ القلة والكثرة يستعملان في الأعداد؛ يكنى بالقلة عن الذلة؛ يكنى بها تارة عن العزة؛ قليل يعبر به عن النفي (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en üstünü veya başını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; dağın yuvarlak üst bölümü, insan başı ve kılıcın başındaki topuz bu çekirdeğin açık uzmanlaşmalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol uzamsal başı ve en üst parçayı bildirir; sayısal azlık ya da büyük kap anlamını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başını veya en üst bölümünü bildirir. Dağın üstteki yuvarlak parçası, insan başı ve kılıcın sap ucundaki topuz bu uzamsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin veya oluşumun başı ya da en üstte bulunan bölümüdür.
Dağın en üstünde yer alan, kimi tanımda yuvarlak biçimli bölümünü adlandırır.
İnsan başı ile kılıcın sap ucundaki başlık veya topuz da aynı üst ve baş kavramıyla adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir şeyin başı ve en üst bölümü üzerinde birleşir; dağ tepesi temel örnektir, insan başı ile kılıç topuzu da aynı biçimsel ve uzamsal çizgide yer alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin ya da doğal oluşumun en üst bölümünü ve başını kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Baş olma ile uzamsal olarak en üstte bulunma çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dağın en üst ve kimi zaman yuvarlak bölümünün adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan başının veya başka bir şeyin baş sayılan üst bölümünün kastedildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük bir küp veya iri kap anlamında birleşir; iki kaplık ölçü ve belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler de aynı kap anlamını somutlaştırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol büyük bir kap türünü ve onun ölçü değerini kapsar; nicelik azlığı veya dağ tepesi anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Büyük küp anlamı çekirdektir; belirli bir bölgeye bağlanan kap adı ile iki kaplık ölçü yalnızca kendi yapılardaki uzmanlaşmalardır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Küpe benzeyen iri kabı adlandıran temel ve en doğal Türkçe karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kabın küp türünde ve olağandan büyük oluşunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kabın özellikle su alması ve büyük kapasitesi öne çıkarıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Büyük kabı ve kaynakta belirtilen su taşıma kapasitesini korur.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس قلة العدد، وليس رأس الجبل
branches.source_phrase_ar: القلة التي جاءت في الحديث مثل قلال هجر هي جرار عظام (jamhara)؛ القلة إناء للعرب كالجرة الكبيرة؛ قلال هجر شبيهة بالحباب (sihah)؛ قلتين يعني هذه الحباب العظام واحدتها قلة؛ قلال هجر؛ القلة منها تأخذ مزادة من الماء (tahdhib)؛ القلة ما أقله الإنسان من جرة وحب (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal inanma ya da dua cevabi degil; korkudan emin olma, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu dali korkunun ziddi olan guven, kalbin yatismasi ve guven verme alaninda toplar. Ayni iddia guvenilir kisi, emanet, guvenli yer ve dayanilir binek gibi turemis ya da baglamli kullanislari da cekirdege baglar.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس تصديق الإيمان من حيث هو تصديق، ولا صيغة آمين في الدعاء، ولا أمن المركبة من أم ومن في قوله أمن هو قانت.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأمن ضد الخوف (ayn;sihah)؛ أصل الأمن طمأنينة النفس وزوال الخوف (mufradat)؛ الأمانة ضد الخيانة ومعناها سكون القلب (maqayis)؛ الأمان إعطاء الأمنة (maqayis;ayn)؛ أمن فلان يأمن أمنا وأمانا وأمنة فهو آمن (tahdhib)؛ استأمن إليه دخل في أمانه (sihah)؛ مأمنه منزله الذي فيه أمنه (mufradat)؛ الأمون الناقة الأمينة الوثيقة أو التي يؤمن فتورها وعثورها (ayn;sihah;mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali acikca tasdik, haber ya da vaadi dogru sayma ve bazi dini kullanislarda hakka boyun egme olarak verir. Provisional cerceve guvene dokunan yanini not eder, fakat dal kimligi korkusuzluk degil tasdik ve kabul iliskisidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik hali degil; bir soz, haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru kabul etme alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem genel tasdik adlari hem de belirli soz obekleri ve dini kullanislar vardir; tanim bunlari yalin guven anlamina genisletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalin ortak cekirdegini tasdik olarak verir ve bir sozun dogru sayilmasini temsil eden ornegi buna baglar. Ayni iddia, daha ozel dini kullanimlarda hakka icten boyun egme, yola girme ve vaatle ilgili dogrulama boyutlarinin eklendigini de gosterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Haber, vaat, hakikat ve dini baglanma kullanimlarini tasdik cekirdegi etrafinda birlestirir.

error_profile.preserves: Dogru sayma, ic kabul ve daha ozel dini baglanma imkanini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Haber veya sozun dogrulanmasi anlatildiginda en dogal karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Tasdik cekirdegini korur.
error_profile.loses: Dini boyun egme ve davranisla baglanma tarafini tam tasimaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dini ve icten kabullenme baglamlarinda tasdikten daha genis sureci aciklar.

error_profile.preserves: Tasdikle birlikte ic kabul ve baglanma tarafini korur.
error_profile.loses: Sade haber tasdiki icin fazla agir ve ozel kalir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Vaat edilen seyin gercek ve guvenilir kilinmasi baglaminda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Vaatle ilgili dogrulama tarafini korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel tasdik ve dini kabullenme alanlarini kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komsu dal kesinlik derecesini ve belirtiye dayali bilgiyi vurgular; bu dal ise kabul etme ve dogrulama eylemine odaklanir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dogru sayma, haber ya da hakikati kabul etme eylemidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kalpte veya goruste karar kilma ve sabit kanaat olusturma alanidir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komsu dal kanaatin baglanmis ve sabit hale gelmesini anlatir; bu dal dogrulama ve kabul iliskisini esas alir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tasdik, haberin veya hakikatin dogru kabul edilmesidir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kalbin yatismasi iki dalda da eslik edebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda yatiskinlik dogru sayma ve kabullenmeden gelir; komsu dalda yatiskinlik korku ve tehlike ihtimalinin kalkmasindan gelir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الإيمان بمعنى التصديق، وتصديق الخبر أو الوعد، والإيمان على سبيل الشريعة أو إذعان النفس للحق حيث نصت المصادر، واستعمال مؤمن بمعنى مصدق الوعد.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الإيمان التصديق (ayn;sihah)؛ وما أنت بمؤمن لنا أي مصدق لنا (maqayis;ayn;mufradat)؛ إذعان النفس للحق على سبيل التصديق (mufradat)؛ المؤمن في صفات الله يصدق ما وعد عبده (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali dua icinde soylenen bir kabul istegi sozu ve bu sozu soyleme eylemi olarak verir. Cerceve, guven ve tasdik dallarindan ayrildigi ve sadece dua cevabi formuluyle ilgili oldugu icin uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik ya da tasdik degil; duada kabul talebini bildiren sabit sozdur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal belirli bir dua sozu ve onu soyleme eylemiyle sinirlidir; buradan genel guven ya da tasdik anlami cikarilmaz.

concept_map.definition: Dua sonunda kabul edilme istegini bildiren ve 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' ya da 'bunu yap' anlaminda aciklanan sabit sozdur. Dal ayrica bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve kaynaklarda aktarılan ad yorumunu da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek, duada kabul istegini bildiren sabit cevap sozudur.
Kaynaklar sozun anlamini 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' veya 'bunu yap' seklinde aciklar.
Bu sozu soyleme eylemi de ayni dal icinde adlandirilir.
Bazi aktarimlarda bu sozun ilahi bir ad oldugu yorumu da dalin yan rivayeti olarak bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak dali dua icinde soylenen ve kabul istegi tasiyan sabit bir soz olarak anlatir. Ayni iddia, bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve sozun anlamina dair 'kabul et' ya da 'oyle olsun' aciklamalarini da icerir; ad yorumu ise bu ortak malzemenin yan aktarimidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dua sonunda soylenen sabit kabul talebi ve onu soyleme eylemi icin genel karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Dua baglamini, kabul istegini ve sabit soz niteligini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sozun dua icindeki anlamini eylemli bicimde cevirmek gerektiginde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Duanin kabul edilmesini isteme tarafini korur.
error_profile.loses: Sabit soz ve onu soyleme eylemi olma tarafini eksiltir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Duanin sonucuna katilma ve gerceklesmesini dileme baglaminda dogal karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Kabul ve gerceklesme istegini korur.
error_profile.loses: Ilahi muhataba yonelen talep kuvvetini ve sozu soyleme eylemini tam tasimaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylem adi olan kullanimda, yani bu sozu telaffuz etme anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sozu soyleme eylemini ve dua baglamini korur.
error_profile.loses: Sozun tek basina anlamini ve ad yorumu yanini kapsamaz.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه آمين في الدعاء بالمد والقصر، والتأمين بمعنى قول آمين، وتفسيرها باستجب أو اللهم افعل أو كذلك فليكن، مع ذكر قول من جعلها اسما من أسماء الله.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الأمن ضد الخوف، ولا الأمانة، ولا الإيمان بمعنى التصديق، ولا أمن التي هي أم من وليست من الباب.
branches.source_phrase_ar: قولنا في الدعاء آمين وتفسيره اللهم افعل (maqayis)؛ التأمين من قولك آمين (ayn)؛ آمين في الدعاء يمد ويقصر ومعناه كذلك فليكن (sihah)؛ آمين يقال بالمد والقصر وهو اسم للفعل ومعناه استجب وأمن فلان إذا قال آمين (mufradat)

Ortak bag kalbin yatismasi ve kabul duygusudur, fakat her dalin siniri guvenlik, tasdik ve dua formulu olarak ayri tutulmalidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ses ve söz yoluyla bir şeyi konuşana doğru yöneltmeyi temel anlam olarak verir; yemeğe çağırmayı ve bir yere yönelmeyi de bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlar olarak gösterir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel seslenme anlamı, yalnızca belirli yapılarda görülen yemeğe çağırma ve bir yere yönelme kullanımlarından ayrı tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın seslenme çekirdeğini kapsar; yemeğe çağırma ile belirli bir yere yönelme anlamları yalnızca kendi yapıları içinde geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Ses ve söz kullanarak birini ya da bir şeyi konuşana doğru yöneltmektir. Yemeğe çağırma ve bir yeri amaçlayıp oraya gitme, bu çekirdeğin yapıya bağlı özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Ses ve söz, yöneltilen kişiyi ya da şeyi konuşana doğru çekmenin aracıdır.
Yemeğe çağırma, yöneltme çekirdeğinin belirli bir etkinliğe bağlı özel kullanımıdır.
Belirli bir yeri amaçlayıp oraya gitme, yerin kişiyi çağırdığı varsayımıyla anlatılan mecazlı bir uzantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynak iddiası, ses ve sözle kendine yöneltme çekirdeğini; yemeğe çağırmayı ve bir yeri amaçlayarak oraya gitmeyi bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlar halinde birlikte sunar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sesli ve sözlü bir çağrının hedefi konuşana ya da onun belirlediği yöne çektiği temel anlam için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ses ve söz aracını, yöneltme hareketini ve konuşana doğru oluşan yönü birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiye seslenip onu konuşana veya belirlenen yere yöneltme bağlamlarında doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Seslenme ve hedefi bir yöne çekme eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yemeğe çağırma ile yerin çağırdığı varsayımına dayanan yönelme uzantılarını tek başına göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca birini yemek için çağıran özel yapı söz konusu olduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir kişiyi ses ve sözle belirli bir etkinliğe yöneltme anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel çağırma çekirdeğini ve yer yönelimi uzantısını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca kişinin belirtilen yeri hedefleyerek oraya yöneldiğini anlatan özel yapı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli bir yere yönelme ve o yeri amaçlama sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Yerin kişiyi çağırdığı varsayımını ve genel seslenme çekirdeğini açıkça taşımaz.

error_profile.preserves: Birini belirli bir şeye yöneltme düşüncesini kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Ses ve sözle kendine yöneltme çekirdeğini ve yer yönelimi uzantısını kapsamaz.
error_profile.adds: Türkçede toplumsal veya resmî bir etkinliğe çağırma çağrışımını öne çıkarabilir.
error_profile.collision: Yalın seslenme ile yapıya bağlı yemeğe çağırma anlamlarının sınırını belirsizleştirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hedefi ses ve sözle konuşana doğru yöneltme ilişkisini kurar; sesin yüksek olması zorunlu değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Çağrının yönünden çok sesin yükseltilmesini ve güçlü biçimde duyurulmasını öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir kişiye sesle ulaşma ve onu çağırma alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda belirleyici unsur sözlü çağrıyla yöneltmedir; komşuda ise çağrının yüksek ve güçlü sesle yapılması başlı başına anlam çekirdeğidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Birini ses ve söz yoluyla kendine doğru yöneltme eylemini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yaklaşmayı isteyen kalıplaşmış bir emir ve ünlem işlevi taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir muhatabı konuşana ya da belirtilen noktaya yaklaşmaya yöneltir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel çağırma eylemidir; komşu dal ise yaklaşma isteğini bildiren belirli bir emir ifadesidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Seslenme aracılığıyla muhatabın yönelmesini sağlayan eylemi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yakın veya uzak muhataba seslenmede kullanılan çağrı parçacıklarını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bir muhataba yöneltilen sözlü çağrı alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal çağırma eyleminin kendisini tanımlar; komşu dal o eylemde kullanılan dil bilgisel seslenme araçlarını tanımlar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı. Yayınlanan üç komşu, çağırma eylemini yüksek ses, yaklaşma emri ve seslenme parçacığından ayırır; diğer adaylar ya daha uzak bir ortak sahne paylaşır ya da kardeş dallardaki ayrı anlamları yineler.
